title: Restoring undefined action. (Purchase Orders page can't be open in latest `main`)
summary: An action body was accidentally removed from the E-Document app, breaking purchase order pages. The action and its references have been restored to fix the compilation error.
key_points: An action that was previously removed had no body or RunObject, causing it to not be emitted
The missing action broke actionref references in purchase order pages
Action bodies have been restored across multiple E-Document pages and extensions
Analyzer that should have caught this issue was disabled during the gate check
Pages can now be opened successfully again
quote: Analyzer disabled on the BCApps gate let a change that removed the body of an action to be merged.
